about: The introitus of the formulary “Saints Philip and James, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: They cried to You, O Lord, in the time of their affliction, and You heard them from heaven, alleluia, alleluia. Exult in the Lord, you just; praise befits the upright. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. They cried to You, O Lord, in the time of their affliction, and You heard them from heaven, alleluia, alleluia.
